title: 1638 Prairie's corner tower and spire
items: The Gothic house at 1638 Prairie now has the tower its old photograph shows: an eight-sided upper storey over the entrance porch, a pointed window in each street face, and a tall spire with a finial rising just past the front gable.
Its sizes are read from that photograph. The faces it does not show, the cladding and the colours are reconstructed and marked as a liberty.
